title: setPauser does not emit an event on rotation of the security-critical pauser role (observability gap)
description: setPauser (L206-208) rotates the security-critical pauser role but emits no event, so off-chain monitors cannot detect the role change without polling storage. The companion missing-zero-check on setPauser was correctly NOT raised because setPauser(0) is documented-intentional ('disable pausing').
impact: None on-chain - observability/monitoring gap only. Hinders off-chain monitoring and incident response on a sensitive role.
attackPath: 1. Owner calls setPauser(newPauser); no event is emitted.
2. Off-chain monitors cannot detect the role change without polling storage.
recommendation: Emit an event (e.g. PauserUpdated(oldPauser, newPauser)) on every setPauser call so the role rotation is observable off-chain.
